name: v0.80.0
body:
## What's Changed
* chore(nix): update prebuilt hashes for v0.79.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2028
* fix(cli): harden approval ids, orphan reaping and lexical why evaluation by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2033
* fix(linux): honour open ports in proxy fallback by @MateSaary in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2042
* fix(macos): allow bypassed sockets under denied directories by @SequeI in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2041
* docs(neps): add nep-0005 for windows enforcement backend by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2032
* fix(supervisor): separate network denial throttling from policy enforcement by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2047
* feat(tool-sandbox): per-command aws_auth + fix scoped-proxy CA env ordering by @nmgrenyi in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2024
* docs(neps): add NEP-0002 for invocation-scoped commands by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/1971
* chore(deps): bump clap_complete from 4.6.9 to 4.6.11 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2057
* chore(deps): bump der from 0.8.1 to 0.8.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2056
* chore(deps): bump thiserror from 2.0.20 to 2.0.21 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2058
* chore(deps): bump jsonc-parser from 0.33.1 to 0.34.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2059
* feat(cli): add command-level keychain_access grant for macOS by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2093
* fix(cli): keep Claude Code on its default Keychain service (#1950) by @ranguard in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2085
* fix(proxy): add serverAuth EKU to minted TLS intercept leaf certificates by @polarctos in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2068
* chore(deps): bump sigstore-sign from 0.11.0 to 0.14.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2060
* chore(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2102
* chore(deps): bump actions/download-artifact from 8.0.1 to 8.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2101
* chore(deps): bump zeroize from 1.9.0 to 1.9.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2096
* chore(deps): bump h2 from 0.4.19 to 0.4.20 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2099
* chore(deps): bump sha1 from 0.10.7 to 0.11.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2098
* chore(deps): bump ignore from 0.4.30 to 0.4.33 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2097
* chore(deps): bump tokio-rustls from 0.26.5 to 0.26.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2100
* docs: clarify OpenCode versions and refresh Pi quickstart by @SequeI in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2103
* chore: release v0.80.0 by @SequeI in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2104
* feat(command-policy): support SHA-256 executable pinning by @SequeI in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2105
* chore(deps): bump quinn-proto to 0.11.18 by @SequeI in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2106

## New Contributors
* @github-actions[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2028
* @nmgrenyi made their first contribution in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2024
* @polarctos made their first contribution in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2068

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/compare/v0.79.0...v0.80.0
